Grinder upgrades that are worth it

Grind consistency does more for a cup than any brewer upgrade. A blade grinder produces a mixture of boulders and dust, and the dust over extracts before the boulders have given anything up.

The Baratza Encore is the usual first recommendation and it deserves the reputation: conical burrs, a serviceable motor, and parts you can still buy in five years.

Stepping up to a hand grinder with a 1Zpresso style burr set gets espresso capable consistency for less money, at the cost of a minute of cranking per dose.

Beyond that the returns flatten out quickly. A four hundred dollar grinder is a real improvement over a hundred dollar one; a fourteen hundred dollar grinder mostly buys speed and a quieter motor.
